class TestTaskManager(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_count_tasks(self) -> None:
        # Create some tasks
        self.manager.create_task("t-1", "Implement auth", TaskPriority.HIGH, ["security", "backend"])
        self.manager.create_task("t-2", "Write docs", TaskPriority.MEDIUM)
        self.manager.create_task("t-3", "Fix CSS", tags=["ui"])
        self.manager.create_task("t-4", "Add dark mode", tags=["ui", "frontend"])
        self.manager.create_task("t-5", "Deploy DB", tags=["infra"])
        self.manager.complete_task("t-2")

        # Test counting all tasks
        self.assertEqual(self.manager.count_tasks(), 5)

        # Test counting completed tasks
        self.assertEqual(self.manager.count_tasks(completed=True), 1)

        # Test counting incomplete tasks
        self.assertEqual(self.manager.count_tasks(completed=False), 4)

        # Test counting tasks with a specific tag
        self.assertEqual(self.manager.count_tasks(tag="ui"), 2)

        # Test counting tasks with a specific tag and completion status
        self.assertEqual(self.manager.count_tasks(tag="ui", completed=False), 2)

        # Test counting tasks with a non-existent tag
        self.assertEqual(self.manager.count_tasks(tag="non-existent"), 0)
